FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.status = 'completed'
  AND orders.total_amount = (SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct / 100)) FROM order_items WHERE order_id = orders.order_id)
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM orders.order_date)

  year;
